html.htmlText: This recently renovated one bedroom apartment is in Ocean Beach, California has one queen and one sofa pullout full sized bed.  We are conveniently located about two blocks from the ocean/sand. We are on the North side of OB near Robb Field and the San Diego River channel. Dog Beach, one of the few San Diego's few beaches that allows dogs 24/7 365 days a year, is just a few minutes walk away.   There are tons of bars, restaurants, coffee carts, and shops all within walking distance.

This is a gated property with many of the units (like this one) opening onto the courtyard with lush gardens and trees.  Newly remodeled with faux granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, washer/dryer, and gated back patio.
The BBQ grill located in the gated courtyard.

Please remember that you will be staying in a home, not a hotel. Therefore we ask that you treat our space with the same respect you would show your own.

If you need anything before, after, or during your stay, please feel free to call, text, or message me through Airbnb.

Couple reminders:

** Only guest(s) in the listing are allowed, no outside guest(s) or visitors are allowed at anytime without prior approval. Please note your reservation may be cancelled immediately with no refund in the even that outside guests are staying or visiting the unit.

** This isn't a party house.

** No smoking is permitted, including Marijuana. We may garnish 2X your cleaning fee if the smell of smoke is present.

- Check out is 11AM

- Check in is between 3PM and 10PM , unless otherwise agreed upon.

- Thank you in advance for respecting our house rules, they are very important to us. Please keep a reasonable volume so as to not disturb our neighbors, and do not invite other guests or have parties. We would appreciate it if you wash any dishes you use during your stay. Please leave the house in the same condition you found it as when you first arrive

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference: The neighborhood is renowned for its pristine beaches, such as the iconic Ocean Beach Pier, where you can enjoy breathtaking ocean views, take leisurely strolls, or try your hand at fishing. The area is also popular for water sports like surfing, paddle boarding, and kayaking, making it a haven for outdoor enthusiasts.

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
Parking can be difficult on the weekends as it's street parking only. **Please be sure to observe the street signs when parking, there certain days/times that are restricted for street sweeping. The side our property is on is restricted every Friday from 7am to 10am.  And across the street is every Wednesday from 7am to 10am** 
That being said,  most  everything in OB is within walking distance, including the Ocean/Beach and many restaurants and stores :)
